scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you have something to say to him,
just talk to me.
You won't even understand what stupid pumkin headed Jack is saying.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
如果你想跟他说什么，
直接跟我说就好。
你根本听不懂那个笨蛋南瓜头杰克在说什么。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh wait, is that a Pumpkin Mojo you are carrying?
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哦等等，你身上带的是南瓜的精髓吗？

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Give it to me. I'll pay you back.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
I just can guess what he will say next. So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
把它给我。我会还给你的。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的...
我都能猜到他接下来要说什么了。那么，你怎么说？

scripts.text: What will he say?
scripts.translation: 他会说什么？

scripts.text: I also know about it.
scripts.translation: 我也知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What will he say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他会说什么？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Jack is not like others. He is halloween Jack.
but one day, he lost his Pumpkin Mojo and turned into depressed Jack..
Pumpkin Mojo was his all.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
杰克跟别人不一样。他是万圣节的杰克。
但有一天，他失去了南瓜的精髓，变成了阴郁的杰克...
南瓜的精髓是他的一切。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, actually that's the main reason Jack came to town.
To find his Pumpkin Mojo. Most suspicious suspect is ^4d4dffDelightful Lude^000000, the one known as Halloween monster
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嗯，其实这才是杰克来到城镇的主要原因。
为了找回他的南瓜的精髓。最可疑的嫌疑人是^4d4dff南瓜魂^000000，也就是那个被称为万圣节魔物的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Why don't you give him back the 'Pumpkin Mojo'.
Don't worry he will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
你为什么不把“南瓜的精髓”还给他呢。
别担心，他会补偿你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compensate?With what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
补偿？用什么补偿？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you bring ^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo^000000 and a pumpkin head that we gave out to you last year,
he will make it to ^00ff00the most fantastic pumpkin hat^000000.
Or if you don't have pumpkin head, you can just bring a ^3d3dff Pumpkin Mojo, a pumpkin, and a cap ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
如果你带来^4d4dff 1个南瓜的精髓^000000和去年我们发给你的南瓜头，
他会把它做成^00ff00最华丽的南瓜帽^000000。
或者如果你没有南瓜头，也可以直接带来^3d3dff 南瓜的精髓、一个南瓜和一顶帽子 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, that Pumpkin Mojo is useless if you just carry it. 
Give it to Jack. Don't you feel pity for him?.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嗯，那个南瓜的精髓如果你只是带着它，那就毫无用处。
把它给杰克吧。你不觉得他可怜吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~Great.
Then, let me see what you got.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
哦~太好了。
那么，让我看看你带了什么。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh, you brought the pumpkin head!
I'll make you to nicer one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哦，你带了南瓜头来！
我会给你做一个更漂亮的。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍后再来。

scripts.text: Oh, good. Make it now!
scripts.translation: 哦，好的。现在就做吧！

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Huh?
 
[Cool Devi]
What? Look at Jack. He has got so dissapointed.
Promise me to give the Pumpkin Mojo back to Jack later someday, will you?
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
嗯？

[酷黛维]
什么？看看杰克。他看起来很失望。
答应我，以后某天把南瓜的精髓还给杰克，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Thanks for giving my thing back, I'll make your hat prettier.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
谢谢你把东西还给我，我会把你的帽子做得更漂亮。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Excited Jack]
Lalala~ lalala~
 
(He starts singing. On a sudden, Jack's aura appeared.)
scripts.translation:
[兴奋的杰克]
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦~

（他开始唱歌。突然，杰克的灵气出现了。）

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
My aura is not like it used to be. Maybe I need more Pumpkin Mojo.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
我的灵气不像以前那样了。也许我需要更多的南瓜的精髓。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的...

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~poor Jack.
Well, someday he'll get back all his Pumpkin Mojo back.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
哎呀，可怜的杰克。
不过总有一天，他会找回属于他的南瓜的精髓的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Wow!
I'll turn your hat to very cool one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
哇！
我会把你的帽子变得非常酷。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Hey,there. You don't seem to have all materials for the fantastic hat.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛维]
嘿，你。你似乎没有集齐制作那顶神奇帽子的所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Hey,there. Why don't you come here and listen to my story.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
嘿，你。为什么不过来听听我的故事呢。

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
I used to be very famous. But now.....
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
Well, I'll just tell you without translating.
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的杰克]
我曾经非常出名。但现在.....

[酷黛维]
他是这么说的...
算了，我直接告诉你吧，不用翻译了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Pumpkin is the gift that God had sent us.
It provides good nutrition and helps you to stay healthy!
Bravo~bravo~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
南瓜是上帝赐予我们的礼物。
它营养丰富，有助于保持健康！
太棒了~太棒了~！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I, Hoirin have always thought about a 
way to eat pumpkin more deliciously.
But all of a sudden, I realized.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我，霍伊琳，一直在思考
如何让南瓜变得更美味。
但突然之间，我意识到了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
If I have that! I can make best the Pumpkin pie!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果我有那个！我就能做出最好的南瓜派！！！！！

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
What's the first image you see when you think of pumpkin?
I see Jack! I think Jack is the most evolved form of pumpkin!
I wonder what does Jack have something special? Can you imagine?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
当你想到南瓜时，脑海中浮现的第一个形象是什么？
我看到的是杰克！我认为杰克是南瓜最进化的形态！
我想知道杰克有什么特别之处？你能想象吗？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I always prefer unique pumpkin dish! Recently, I found out that there are many kinds of Jack in the world 
and the extreme class Jack has blue aura around his body!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我总是偏爱独特的南瓜料理！最近，我发现世界上有很多种类的杰克
而极致的杰克身上环绕着蓝色的灵气！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Guess what?! it was Halloween Jack!
Halloween Jack has somthing that is concentrated with pumpkin.
It is called ^4d4dffPumpkin Mojo^000000. Only if i have it, i can finish making my special pie.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你猜怎么着？！那是万圣节杰克！
万圣节杰克拥有一种浓缩了南瓜精华的东西。
它叫做^4d4dff南瓜的精髓^000000。只有拥有它，我才能完成我的特制派。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Bring me the ingredients!
I'll make you a very special pie right away!
You'll get addicted to it.
Don't be surprised after trying it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
把材料带给我！
我会立刻为你做一个非常特别的派！
你会对它上瘾的。
尝过之后别惊讶。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
......................
You seem to be such a passionate person.
So, what's the ingredient anyway.?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
......................
你看起来是个很热情的人。
那么，材料到底是什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Good question!
To make my special Pumpkin pie, I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
好问题！
要制作我的特制南瓜派，我需要
^4d4dff1 南瓜的精髓
2 南瓜
2 鸡蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Just Bring Pumpkin Mojo, Pumpkin, and a Egg.
Leave the rest for me..You'll get to try the best pumkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
只要带南瓜的精髓、南瓜和鸡蛋来就好。
剩下的交给我...你会尝到最棒的南瓜派！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Hm..You'll regret it!
Hoirin's pumpkin pie is just so delicious.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
哼...你会后悔的！
霍伊琳的南瓜派可是非常美味的。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
So, did you bring all materials?
Were there anything hard to find?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
那么，你把材料都带齐了吗？
有没有什么很难找的东西？

scripts.text: I brought all ingredients.
scripts.translation: 我带齐了所有材料。

scripts.text: How can I get eggs?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么弄到鸡蛋？

scripts.text: No,I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
You are right!
You brought all things right. Give it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
没错！
你把东西都带对了。快给我！！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Abracadabra~~
Abracadabra~~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
阿布拉卡达布拉~~
阿布拉卡达布拉~~！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ta-da(h)!
Here it is~ help yourself.
It'll be good for your health. I added extra nutrient in it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
当当(h)！
就是它~请随意享用。
这对你的健康很有好处。我额外加了营养。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
No!! This is not enough. I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
 at least.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
不！！这还不够。我至少需要
^4d4dff1 南瓜的精髓
2 南瓜
2 鸡蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Egg?
Well, actually I know someone who can help you.
There's a man who raise many chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
鸡蛋？
嗯，其实我认识一个能帮你的家伙。
有个男子养了很多小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I can send you to where he is if you want.
^4d4dffBut only for once^000000.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果你愿意，我可以把你送到他那里。
^4d4dff但只有一次机会^000000。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我过去。

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ok, go get the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
好，去拿鸡蛋吧。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Do you think you can go without my help?!
Ok! go ahead.
Do you know where it is?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你觉得没有我的帮忙也能去吗？！
好吧！去吧。
你知道在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
if you go to ^4d4dfffarm of Skelington Town at Neiflheim^000000, you'll meet Chicken Masta. He raises chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果你去^4d4dff普隆德拉的骷髅镇农场^000000，你会遇到炸鸡大师。他养小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Next time, don't forget to bring 
all the ingredients for pumpkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
下次，别忘了带齐做南瓜派的所有材料！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hey there, if you have something to say to Loli Ruri, talk to me.
She's not used to human language.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嘿，如果你想对萝莉·露莉说什么，就跟我说话吧。
她不习惯人类的语言。

scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！

然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi~Where's the pumpkin pie?
Humans make them, don't they?
Do you have it then?
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
黛维~南瓜派在哪里？
是人类做的，对吧？
你有吗？
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
If you have a pumpinkin pie, can I have one?
Cause we are the victim if Loli Ruri gets mad.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
如果你有南瓜派，能给我一个吗？
因为如果萝莉·露莉生气了，我们就是受害者。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well I'm not saying that I want it for free.
Don't worry, I won't let you down.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我可不是说想要白拿。
别担心，我不会让你失望的。

scripts.text: Give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 把南瓜派给他

scripts.text: Do not give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 不把南瓜派给他

scripts.text: Huh? What pumkin pie?
scripts.translation: 什么南瓜派？

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Thanks for the pumkin pie!
Here, take this.
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
谢谢你的南瓜派！
拿着这个。
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
As I promised, I'll give you something worth the pie.
Hang on....
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
正如我所承诺的，我会给你一些配得上这个派的东西。
稍等...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hmm...This would be good.
Here take this, and thanks again~
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嗯...这个不错。
拿着吧，再次感谢~

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Are you kidding me?
Where's the pumpkin pie! Don't try to lie to me!
 
[Deviruchi]
Say she..Seems like she's very angry...You are in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[萝莉·露莉]
你在开玩笑吗？
南瓜派在哪里！别想骗我！
 
[小恶魔]
她是这么说的...看起来她很生气...你麻烦大了。

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi!!!!!You are the one who told me that I can get the pumpkin pie if I stand here and wait.
Watch your back!
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she..Huh?!!Me?!!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Where did the chicken have gone?!
Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
小鸡都跑到哪里去了？！
哦，嘿，陌生人。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
This town is too dangerous for you to hang around.
You'd better go back to where you came from....
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这个城镇对你来说太危险了，别在这里逗留。
你最好回到你来的地方去....

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
...Are you looking for eggs?
Recently, people are asking me for eggs to make some kind of pie....are you one of them?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
...你在找鸡蛋吗？
最近，人们都来找我买鸡蛋做某种派....你是其中之一吗？

scripts.text: Actually, yes. I came here to get some eggs.
scripts.translation: 是的，我来买鸡蛋

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Ok. But some of my chickens ran away,
so I have no eggs much left.
1000 zeny for 2 eggs! how's that?
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
好吧。但我的一些小鸡跑掉了，
所以我没剩多少鸡蛋了。
1000 Zeny 买 2 个鸡蛋！怎么样？

scripts.text: Ok,I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 好，我买了

scripts.text: I'll just buy one.
scripts.translation: 我只买一个

scripts.text: Whew~it's too expensive.
scripts.translation: 呼~太贵了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
谢谢。
这是你的鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Hey this is not enough~
1000zeny per each, so if you buy two,that means 2000zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
嘿，这不够啊~
每个1000 Zeny，买两个的话就是2000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
谢谢。
这是你的鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough money...
It's 1000 zeny per each.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你似乎钱不够...
每个1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Well...I know it's liitle bit expensive but as I told you, my chickens ran away.
You have to understand.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
嗯...我知道有点贵，但正如我告诉你的，我的小鸡跑掉了。
你要体谅一下。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Let me tell you just one thing!
If you don't want to die,
you'd better run away. It's too dangerous in here.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
让我告诉你一件事！
如果你不想死的话，
最好快跑。这里太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Do you need eggs?...
Then, help me first.
8 of my chickens ran away.
I just don't know where they are.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你需要鸡蛋吗？...
那么，先帮个忙。
我的8只小鸡跑掉了。
我完全不知道它们在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I don't expect all chickens to come back home.
Only if you find me one of them, I'll sell three eggs for you.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我不指望所有小鸡都能回家。
只要你帮我找回一只，我就卖三个鸡蛋给你。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Isn't it a great deal?
Chickens must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这不是很划算吗？
小鸡应该就在附近某处。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to bring back chickens to me if you find one,
Just insert the word ^4d4dff'Return'^000000.
.........
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
如果你找到一只小鸡，不用把它带回来给我，
只要输入单词 ^4d4dff'Return'^000000。
.........

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
It's a spell to make chickens to go back home.
.........
Don't forget the word 'Return'!
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
这是一个让小鸡回家的咒语。
.........
别忘了那个单词'Return'！

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I hope you can find my chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
希望你能找到我的小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Oh, you came back. I've been waiting for you.
And thanks for the chickens you sent me.
They are saftly kept in the henhouse, in case of running away again.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
哦，你回来了。我一直在等你。
还有，谢谢你送回来的小鸡。
它们被安全地关在鸡舍里，以防再次跑掉。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I didn't forget what we have promised.
Tell me how many eggs you want.
It's 1000zeny per each.
And maximum 3 is all you can get.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我没忘记我们的约定。
告诉我你想要多少个鸡蛋。
每个1000 Zeny。
最多只能买3个。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to buy it, if you don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
如果你不需要，就不必买了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
What did I tell you.
I'm going to sell only three eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
我跟你说过什么来着。
我只卖三个鸡蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
你似乎Zeny不够。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Here you are.
But no more.
If you want more eggs, find me more chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸鸡大师]
给你。
但不能再多了。
如果你想要更多鸡蛋，就帮我找回更多小鸡。

scripts.text:

Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

这个城镇对你来说太危险了，别在这里逗留。
你最好回到你来的地方去....

scripts.translation: 正在打盹的小鸡。

scripts.text:
Oh, this must be Chicken Masta's chicken.
I should insert the magic word.
scripts.translation:
哦，这一定是炸鸡大师的小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Hello.
I'm Loli Ruri's faithful and cute Familiar.
Do you have an invitation from Loli Ruri?
That's a kind of^4d4dffa special ticket to Niflheim^000000..
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你好。
我是萝莉·露莉忠诚又可爱的使魔。
你有萝莉·露莉的邀请函吗？
那是一张^4d4dffa前往尼弗尔海姆的特制门票^000000...

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 没有，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Do you want to go to Niflheim?
It's available during Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你想去尼弗尔海姆吗？
只有在万圣节期间才能前往。

scripts.text: Yes, I do
scripts.translation: 是的，我想

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 没有，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
I checked your ticket.
You can go there now
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
我检查了你的门票。
你现在可以过去了。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
You're a liar.
You don't have the ticket!
I'll suck up all your blood, you liar!
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你是个骗子。
你没有门票！
我要吸干你的血，你这个骗子！

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
Actually, it's useless to have a special ticket to Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好吧。
其实，持有尼弗尔海姆的特制门票也没用。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
If you want to ask something, give a piece of pumpkin pie to Loli Ruri.
He likes it.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好吧。
如果你想问点什么，就给萝莉·露莉一块南瓜派吧。
他很喜欢吃。
